meta.task: design-time mutation test of the QUALITY-85 six-field tuple refusal (heldout-gen-v4r43.py tuple check), BEFORE it is coded
meta.golden_semantics: for every carrier: observed = observed_features(envelope) restricted to the six REQUIRED fields; declared = carriers[].declared_features (the single R41-CL1 key, exactly six fields); any field inequality refuses the manifest: exit 3 declared_tuple_unobserved, NO manifest write, per-carrier diff list on stdout

sources.c02_observed: corpus/evidence/round-42/c2/heldout/C02/envelope.json normalized_result (via observed_features, tools/round-42/c2-counter.py:581) and run.json summary
sources.predictor_equals_declared: tools/round-42/heldout-gen-v4.py: carriers[].declared_features = declared_tuple(predictor(factors)); the predictor output and the declared key are identical by construction for every carrier
sources.class_expected_has_no_features: manifest declared_schema: 'There is no `declared` key and no `class_expected.features` key'; named-class class_expected = {label, action, reported_only}; combo class_expected = null

mutants.title: checker REA invocation drops the per-class --max-depth
mutants.fault: the tuple check re-runs REA itself (or re-observes) with the default depth (3) for every carrier instead of the carrier's recorded per-class max_depth (C02: --max-depth 1); the observation procedure is no longer the one the declared tuple was measured under
mutants.c02_detail: C02's envelope was produced at --max-depth 1 (run.json rea_argv) which minted depth-limited; under the mutant's uncapped observation the depth ceiling is never hit at the same point, so the observed tuple is measured under a different procedure and the check cannot bind the declared tuple (whether the resulting tuple textually matches is seed-dependent; the procedure is wrong regardless)

aggregate.design_rule_for_R43C1Gen: the tuple check must (1) bind carriers[].declared_features as the single declared source, (2) extract observed_features from the REA envelope produced under the carrier's recorded max_depth, (3) compare all six fields by set-canonicalized equality, (4) treat any missing/None tuple source as a loud refusal, (5) on any difference exit 3 and write no manifest. ST-C02-REAL alone kills 10 of the 16 C02-blind mutants; the remaining 6 (M01, M03, M04, M05, M06, M20) each need exactly one single-field selftest, all already enumerated.
